description: This file contains the implementation of a text aggregator class 'SkipTagsAggregator' that extends 'SimpleTextAggregator'. It is designed to prevent sentence boundary detection within specified start/end tags by buffering text and recognizing tag boundaries during text aggregation. The class coordinates with auxiliary functions and data structures to identify start/end tags in the input stream, ensuring that tagged content is processed as a unit without being split at sentence boundaries.

classes.name: SkipTagsAggregator
classes.description: A subclass of SimpleTextAggregator that buffers text to prevent sentence boundary detection within specified start/end tag pairs. It manages internal state to recognize when it is inside tagged content and adjusts its aggregation behavior accordingly.

methods.name: __init__(self, tags: Sequence[StartEndTags])
methods.description: Initializes the aggregator with a sequence of StartEndTags specifying which tag pairs should prevent sentence splitting. Sets internal state variables.

methods.name: AsyncIterator[Aggregation] aggregate(self, text: str)
methods.description: Asynchronously processes input text character-by-character, updating tag recognition state. When outside tags, it performs sentence boundary detection via the parent's method; inside tags, it buffers text without checking for sentence boundaries.

methods.name: handle_interruption(self)
methods.description: Handles processing interruptions by resetting internal tag state and clearing buffers.

methods.name: reset(self)
methods.description: Resets the aggregator's internal state, discarding any buffered text and tag recognition status.

ctags.name: aggregate
ctags.pattern: /^    async def aggregate(self, text: str) -> AsyncIterator[Aggregation]:$/
